title: fix(android): bold Inter and IBM Plex styles likely render in the system font
body:
**Size:** S  
**Found by:** the final review of #111. That branch avoids this for the new Archivo styles, which carry no `fontWeight`.

Probably silent today: on Android, any text style that pairs a runtime-loaded font with a `fontWeight` of 700 or more is likely drawn in the system bold font (Roboto), not its own face. Web and iOS are unaffected. Nothing errors, and the web screenshots can't show it.

### Why (traced in source, not yet seen on a device)

- expo-font 57's Android loader registers each runtime-loaded family under `Typeface.NORMAL` only.
- React Native 0.86 maps any `fontWeight` ≥ 700 to the `BOLD` style. The lookup misses the registered `NORMAL` entry, looks for `fonts/<family>_bold.ttf`, finds nothing, and falls back to `Typeface.create(family, BOLD)`, the system font.
- Weights of 600 and below map to `NORMAL` and render correctly.

### Affected `theme/tokens.ts` `typography` entries

Every entry whose `fontWeight` is `'700'` or `'800'` (as of #114 part 1; 2.0 deleted `heroNumber`, `scoreHero` and `chipLabel`):

- `badgeNumber` (IBM Plex Mono Bold): Results' photo-less circles use it
- `screenTitle`, `bodyEmphasis` (Inter Bold)
- `wordmark`, `wordmarkHero` (Inter ExtraBold)

### Work

- [ ] Confirm on an Android build. Compare Home's wordmark or a screen title with the web capture; Roboto is visibly wider and rounder.
- [ ] If confirmed, drop `fontWeight` from every entry whose family is a single-weight runtime font. Each family name already selects one file. Add a test, like #111's Archivo one, that no such entry sets `fontWeight`.
- [ ] Decide the release route. It is JS-only, so the release rules allow a fix to a shipped version on its release branch over the air. That is a release decision for the owner.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On Android, the bold Inter and Plex styles render in Inter and Plex.
- [ ] iOS and web are unchanged: `design/screens` diffs show no change.
why: The issue hands the owner the release route, so the skill asks.
